physics_goals.value: Study dense baryon-rich QCD matter in heavy-ion collisions at the NICA collider (design of the Multi-Purpose Detector for NICA)

summary.plain: MPD (Multi-Purpose Detector) is the main detector for heavy-ion collisions at JINR's NICA collider. It is being assembled around a large superconducting solenoid and is to be moved to the collision point by the end of October 2026 for the collider's xenon run, to study dense nuclear matter.
summary.technical: Multi-Purpose Detector at NICA: superconducting solenoid (0.57 T design field) around a time projection chamber, with time-of-flight, electromagnetic calorimeter and forward hadron calorimeters, designed for heavy-ion collisions at 4-11 GeV per nucleon pair; under assembly in the MPD hall, TPC installation planned for August 2026 and move to the interaction point by end of October 2026.
